movelist.name: Whirlpool
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Water Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Hydration’s Frequency is ignored if used during Rainy Weather.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Absorb Force
abilities.trigger: The user is damaged by a Physical Attack
abilities.effect: The user takes damage as if the attack was resisted one step further.
